einzeiler: Building a multi-million dollar wellness empire and overcoming an eating disorder.
kurzfassung: Nutritionist and author Emily English discusses her journey from battling an eating disorder to building a multi-million-dollar wellness brand. She shares practical nutrition tips, the psychology behind food choices, and the realities of growing a personal brand on social media. The conversation also covers gut health, dealing with industry trends, and the importance of financial independence for women.
stichpunkte: Overcoming an eating disorder led Emily English to study nutrition at King's College London.
Cooking is framed as a fundamental act of self-love and respect for the body rather than just meal preparation.
Health marketing has historically preyed on vulnerabilities and quick fixes, an industry narrative English actively works to change.
A chance encounter with modeling at age 17 triggered body scrutiny, sparking a severe six-month battle with orthorexic behaviors.
Content creation started on Instagram during COVID, eventually scaling to over three million engaged followers through recipe sharing.
The transition from a one-to-one nutritionist to a multi-faceted business involved learning to price services and products at true value.
Founding the supplement company Epitome stemmed from a desire to solve gut health problems with scientifically backed, high-absorption products.
Maintaining direct involvement in editing and community engagement prevents the brand from losing touch with its core audience.

clips.hook: Can changing how you think about food change how you feel?
clips.text: The guest explains that psychological framing significantly alters how satiated people feel after consuming identical foods.

clips.hook: Why US food ingredients differ so drastically from Europe
clips.text: A casual breakfast order at a major US coffee chain revealed an excessive number of additives compared to simpler alternatives.

clips.hook: How to eat healthy when you have zero time
clips.text: Busy professionals can easily prepare healthy meals by planning ahead and dedicating just a few minutes to basic kitchen prep.

clips.hook: The brutal reality of stranger judgment on social media
clips.text: Public visibility creates a vulnerability to anonymous criticism that far outweighs the opinions of close friends and family.

clips.hook: What does a successful wellness entrepreneur buy on impulse?
clips.text: An unannounced flight to Greece served as the spontaneous recent purchase on a credit card before informing her spouse.

beschreibung:
Want to know how to turn your biggest struggle into a multi-million dollar business? Top BSc Nutritionist, viral chef, and entrepreneur Emily English joins Maggie Sellers Reum on Hot Smart Rich to spill how she built an empire out of her eating disorder recovery. Emily gets real about 2000s diet culture, launching a successful probiotic supplement brand, and why you should never apologize for getting rich. Plus, she shares expert nutrition hacks on natural GLP-1s, gut health, liquid calories, and beating travel bloat.

From struggling with self-image to becoming one of the internet’s favorite food creators, Emily reveals how healing her relationship with food accidentally launched her career. She breaks down the reality of starting a business from scratch, navigating the supplement industry, and scaling a wellness brand from her phone.Whether you’re here for the unfiltered founder advice, science-backed gut health tips, or a total mindset shift around money and ambition, Emily reveals all the details.
